articles.topic: RAGの検索・回答の分離評価
articles.accessNote: Complete public article body captured as text. Author-reported measurements, not independently rerun. Code excerpts were read without executing them.
articles.facts: Author used qwen3:8b on M1 16 GB with 25 questions about a three-page fictional document. Of 12 errors across three initial settings, 11 already had evidence. At 500 characters and k=4, relaxed wording matching yielded 24 versus 21, thinking mode yielded 25 with 22 seconds median versus 1.4 seconds baseline. One run per setting, keyword plus manual scoring.

articles.facts: Go 1.24.7, yaml.v3 v3.0.1, two fixtures. go test passed both because Valid ignored empty currency and the decoder dropped the unknown key. draft-07 JSON Schema via yajsv rejected both problems in the same file. articles.title: 縦動画の文字のはみ出しを、ffmpeg と Python の標準ライブラリだけで落とす

articles.accessNote: Complete public article body captured as text. Author-reported measurements, not independently rerun. Code excerpts were read without executing them.
articles.facts: ffmpeg at 4 fps and 270 by 480 grayscale; fixed bands and luminance rules, minimum two consecutive samples for persistent violations. Margin and centering are distinct. Fourteen synthetic/invalid fixtures passed; 9.4–9.5 seconds on four cores, three runs. No detection of overlapping letters or bad line breaks.
